name: Chang'e 6
intro: Ni hao! I'm Chang'e 6. My mission: bring back the first EVER rocks from the far side.
We're going to the Apollo basin. Yes, that's its name. Funny, huh?
From the far side we can't see Earth, so Queqiao-2 relays our messages.
Two days to dig and drill, then off we go.
briefing: Queqiao-2 is online. We're over the giant South Pole-Aitken basin.
fact: Chang'e 6 brought back 1.9 kg of far side rocks in 2024.
